name: Algli
description: An elderly former tanner who lost her family to ghouls and joined a cult trying to summon the Buried Lord, then allies with Liesa.

timeline.summary: Algli's husband and sons die in a ghoul attack on the family tannery, and she survives by setting the tannery aflame.
timeline.quote: Her husband and her youngest son threw themselves between her and the ghouls, and she set the tannery aflame.

timeline.summary: A ghoulcaller raises Algli's dead family; she meets Olutio and together they slay him, and Olutio first speaks to her of the Buried Lord.
timeline.quote: Standing over their fresh graves, Olutio first spoke to her of the Buried Lord.

timeline.summary: The three cultists perform the last ritual in the clearing with a goat, but nothing seems to happen.
timeline.quote: A goat, hooves and horns, in the image of a demon.

timeline.summary: Sruta calls Olutio and Algli fools and leaves, and Olutio follows, leaving Algli alone with her despair.
timeline.quote: "You were always a fool, Olutio," she said.

timeline.summary: Algli finds a wounded angel behind her who says she is compelled to answer the call and that the Buried Lord is hungry.
timeline.quote: "But the Buried Lord has never been one to protect. He is here, and he is hungry."

timeline.summary: Algli bandages Liesa's wound and tells her about the Travails and the fall of the angels.
timeline.quote: Algli bandaged the angel's ribs firmly

timeline.summary: Liesa introduces herself as an archangel who once led the Flight of Dusk and asks Algli to help her rebury the Buried Lord.
timeline.quote: "I am Liesa, archangel who once lead the Flight of Dusk.

timeline.summary: Liesa and Algli find Olutio's gutted body.
timeline.quote: They found the gutted remains of Olutio first

timeline.summary: The Buried Lord devours Sruta in front of them and greets Liesa as an old friend.
timeline.quote: On the last word his teeth sunk into Sruta, snuffing her screams with a gruesome tear.

timeline.summary: The Buried Lord offers Liesa an alliance if she hands over Algli, and she refuses.
timeline.quote: "Give me the third, and she will be my last."

timeline.summary: Liesa drives her spear into the Buried Lord's spine and he vanishes, but then he erupts from the ground and seizes Algli.
timeline.quote: Liesa drove the spear deep into the demon's spine.

timeline.summary: Algli chants the old rites and feeds the Buried Lord's strength; Liesa orders her to fall silent.
timeline.quote: As the cultist chanted, the darkness soaked into the demon.

timeline.summary: Algli offers her life and thrusts her torch into the Buried Lord's mouth, and Liesa channels the fire and hope through her spear to behead him.
timeline.quote: With both hands, Algli thrust her torch into the roof of the Buried Lord's gaping maw.

timeline.summary: Algli offers to forge the Buried Lord's remains into Liesa's armor and to serve her; Liesa asks for an alliance instead and Algli swears to be her ally.
timeline.quote: "As I breathe and hope, my lady Liesa.

relations.note: She swears to be Liesa's ally.
relations.quote: You have me as your ally.

pages_say.description: An elderly former tanner who lost her family to ghouls and joined a cult trying to summon the Buried Lord, then allies with Liesa.
